description: agent.rows asked for a page past the end of the data, and it is a SUCCESS, not a refusal (PG3). `agents` is [] — an array, never null — `total` still says 7 because the store still holds seven agents, and `page` echoes 40 because the daemon does not silently move a caller to the last page it likes better. The three together are what a table needs to say "there is no page 40" without inventing an error: a client that deleted rows under a page 7 will land here, and an empty list with an honest total is the whole truth in one round trip.
